field.value: Which colors and sizes are available?
Grey and Black, with available sizes 36-50. Send the quantity needed for each color and size when requesting a quotation.
Knit and KPU upper, textile lining, Kevlar puncture-resistant insert layer, TPU outsole and steel toe cap.
What are the minimum order and wholesale prices?
Minimum order: 2 pairs. 2-49 pairs: USD 14.00/pair; 50-99 pairs: USD 13.50/pair; 100+ pairs: USD 12.50/pair. Freight and order terms are quoted separately.
How can I request a quotation?

Send quantity, color and size breakdown, destination and packing requirements. Ready to ship within 7 days for confirmed available stock / Non-customized orders up to 100 pairs. Larger or customized orders: timing confirmed separately. This is preparation/dispatch timing, not arrival at the destination.
